mission.title: Asset Assessment
mission.description: Question a maintenance program suspected of aiding the hardline saboteurs.

npc.say: Take him over to Agent Wilson.
Agent Wilson will want to talk to that piece of vaporware.
Take that obsolete piece of code to Agent Wilson.
You want to talk to Agent Wilson.

phase.briefing: Operative, we suspect that one of our hardline junction box maintenance programs may have betrayed us, and is now assisting an unknown group in sabotaging junction boxes. Interrogate this program and learn the truth of the matter.

enter.say: The hardline maintenance program, named Stewart The Mechanic, will be found inside that building. Question him closely about the hardline sabotage, but do not cause him any irreparable damage.

talk.say: Junction box sabotage? Now would I do a thing like that? Oh wait... yes, I would! Too bad you won't live to tell anyone about it!
Prepare to defend yourself, {player}--it appears as though Stewart The Mechanic had an ambush ready for us. You will have to remove Stewart The Mechanic from this area for further questioning.

done.say: Excellent. Now bring the traitorous program known as Stewart The Mechanic to us for interrogation and reprogramming. I will give you an updated waypoint once you get him outside.

objective.text: Lead Stewart The Mechanic out of the area

talk.say: Bah! You can't make me talk!

objective.text: Do not let Stewart The Mechanic die

phase.briefing: A waypoint showing the interrogation center's location is uploading to you now. Take Stewart The Mechanic there... alive.

enter.say: Take Stewart The Mechanic to Agent Wilson, who you will find in that building.

objective.text: Take Stewart The Mechanic to Agent Wilson

talk.say: Hey! Where are you taking me?

done.say: You can get out of there now... boy, I wouldn't want to be in Stewart The Mechanic's shoes right now.
I... I didn't do it. I was set up! You have to believe me!
Thank you, human. Oh, don't worry about Stewart The Mechanic. We will be taking very good... care of him.

objective.text: Do not let Stewart The Mechanic die

complete.say: Give our regards to Agent Gray.
The Machines do not tolerate traitors.

mission.finish: Our thanks for helping to root out that traitor in our midst, operative. I have no doubt that we will able to convince him of the error of his ways... permanently.
